value.answer: This is often a strained neck muscle from sleeping in an awkward position, and it usually eases on its own. A warm pack and gentle movement can help. Watch for fever, headache, sore throat or vomiting.
value.triage: Call 811 if any of those show up, the pain gets worse, or it isn't better in a few days. Go to the ER or call 911 now for a fall or injury, drooling, trouble swallowing or breathing, weakness or numbness, or if they seem not themselves.
